tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table rows. Default ground for text.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: inputs, track of meters, table headers.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons). 3:1 on surface-1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-0/1/2. 14:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, timestamps. 6:1+ on surface-0/1.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Aurora teal. Primary actions, links, selected states. Text on surface-1 passes 6:1.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed for brand; text on brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, brand tints, quiet highlights.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: dawn
tokens.usage: First light. Brand moments only (logo, cover, hero). Never a status colour, never text.

tokens.name: dawn-soft
tokens.usage: Warm tint for onboarding and empty states.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Critical patient status, destructive actions, errors. Text on surface-1 and critical-soft.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Background of critical alerts and pills.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Text on a critical fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Under observation, values approaching limits. Text on surface-1 and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning pills and banners.

tokens.name: stable
tokens.usage: Stable patient, values in range, success. Text on surface-1 and stable-soft.

tokens.name: stable-soft
tokens.usage: Background of stable pills.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information: discharge pending, scheduled, transfers.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info pills and banners.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px offset.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Patient transferred from the emergency department at 14:32.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and table headers.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers in tables, bed codes, times.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, pill inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Pill and input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on dense dashboards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons, chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, banners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and meters.
